svg.aria-label: Animated architecture of the industrial defect detection MLOps chain
svg.title: Industrial Defect Detection - animated MLOps architecture
svg.text: INDUSTRIAL DEFECT DETECTION · LIVE DATA / MODEL FLOW

g.text: DVC versions the MVTec AD dataset and feeds the training pipeline
Training: ResNet18 + YOLOv8n, every run tracked in MLflow
Best models exported to ONNX (fidelity check < 1e-4)
FastAPI loads the ONNX models in ONNX Runtime
The user uploads an image: POST /predict
The API returns JSON: label, confidence, bounding boxes
Wrong prediction? The user clicks 'Report an error'
Evidently compares production images with the training data
Feedback pushed to GitHub: the CT workflow is triggered
CT: retrain on new data, then the non-regression gate
CI gate: a metric below its threshold raises an alert
Validated image deployed on Kubernetes with 2 replicas
